cost_model.definition: Required reduction of current G3 value to match fresh equal-ruler G1; necessary recovery only, not predicted attainable benefit.
cost_model.no_pooling: R38 spans use16/c16/fixed1024 with observers and no2targetwarm; conditional hotspot ranking only, no summing four ranks/nested spans, no direct R40 critical-path attribution.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Packed C1 preparation causes CPU/NPU synchronization or packing/data movement on the prefilling critical path and interferes with concurrent decode.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Largest existing conditional selected-function span; R40 tail and TPOT remain worse after equal warmup.
hypotheses_ranked.not_proven: A Python call span includes queued device waits; neither exclusive CPU work nor removable service time is established.
hypotheses_ranked.confirm: Correlate all-rank CPU launch/gaps, NPU transfers/kernels and dependency ordering around real prefill; quantify timeline union/critical path at actual shapes.
hypotheses_ranked.disprove: C1 calls overlap other work or their critical-path union cannot cover meaningful necessary recovery.

hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Mixed native fallback, graph/batch transitions or cross-rank waiting dominate residual overhead.
hypotheses_ranked.evidence: Second-largest existing conditional selected-function span; current graph proof is bounded replay evidence, not every-token/all-rank graph coverage.
hypotheses_ranked.confirm: Map decode graph replay/eager transition, actual batch sizes and HCCL cross-rank spread to the same captured window.
hypotheses_ranked.disprove: Matched native/HYPIC critical path has no material additional fallback/graph/communication gap.

closed_or_deprioritized: Do not rerun R34 prefix-output or unchanged R40 formal matrix.
Do not multiply R36/R39 bounded effects into service forecasts.
Do not remove finite/snapshot/event ownership guards. Their small observed spans supply no admitted recovery budget.

official_image_inventory.container_boundary: CPU filesystem read only, --network none --read-only; no devices/ports/model/dataset mounts, no torch/NPU import or allocation.
official_image_inventory.supported_route: Official --profiler-config.profiler=torch and torch_profiler_dir; POST /start_profile and /stop_profile, lazily per worker. No framework rewrite.
observed_constraints: Actual editable packages are /vllm-workspace, absent from naive sys.path directory search; resolve mapping and real import path, not a guessed site-packages path.
Actual TorchNPUProfilerWrapper uses Level1/PipeUtilization CPU+NPU, with_modules from torch_profiler_with_stack, with_stack=False.
NPU wrapper does not forward torch_profiler_record_shapes or torch schedule warmup/active settings; do not claim those are effective merely from CLI config.
WorkerProfiler auto-stops when profiling_for_iters > max_iterations, not >=. Need original-source HOST boundary controls and actual step-call mapping before choosing exact <=8-step bound.
Profiler start/stop catches/logs exceptions. HTTP200 alone does not prove collection. Require four-rank raw files, valid trace spans and closed parse before attribution.
msmonitor daemon conflicts with torch profiler; verify actual runtime config before launch.

boundary_controls.scope: AST-selected original official WorkerProfiler class with fake _start/_stop only; no torch import/NPU trace/inference proof.

capture_admission.implementation: New bounded HOST controller/workload/auditor only; freeze new common source map/contracts/new roots. Keep438algorithm Python bytes/math/finite/snapshot/eventwrites/durability unchanged. Official profiler configuration is diagnostic variable; component/IO/prefix observers remainOFF.
before_device: Read narrow cannbot guidance if present; prove actual serving imported profiler objects and worker step path/source hashes.
Original-source HOST tests for cap/stop/error/missing trace behavior; actual base-consumed launch constructor/profile args/source and pinned image load.
Freeze matched native/HYPIC diagnostic workload and exact target warmups, first-phase trigger and actual captured step scope. Distinguish prefill/decode by trace evidence, not assumed labels.
Fresh ma/direct, image/model/input/source/new root and name, empty physical0-3 and all102ports, >=4GiB free cache; observed startup/request/trace parse+audit+cleanup budget must fit fixed deadline.
Only first arm valid/parsed/exact released allows fresh admission of matched second arm; original peer/exact handle/raw only; no unknown restart.
capture_admission.bounds: Prefer one bounded <=8-worker-step CPU+NPU capture after actual full target warmups; verify the exact cap semantics first. Full1024 workload may continue outside record window. Enforce raw size/free-space/deadline guards in HOST, retain original data, always stop/parse profiler before exact cleanup.
capture_admission.analysis: Timeline gaps -> phase/step latency -> operators/kernels+actual shapes if emitted -> memory transfers -> HCCL/rank spread -> source; do not sum overlapping streams/ranks as removable time.
capture_admission.scope: Diagnostic timings are not new performance evidence. No local algorithm treatment before a material measured critical-path opportunity and one-variable numerical/quality guard.

prior_canary.scope: Old eager17 bounded catalog proof only. No current438 full381/per-arm runtime budget. Do not extrapolate linear timing or alter denominator.

quality_preparation.remaining: Current graph loader supports catalog/evidence policy in source, but actual full quality launch/audit mapping, baseline variability and current-source budget still needed. Old eager source/disabled lifecycle policies must not be relabeled as graph438 proof.
